name: Novanian Grog (Aged)
description: This grog features a pungent odor and a strong kick. As an action, you can apply this substance to a creature within 5 feet. For the next 10 minutes, the creature experiences a high that increases their current and maximum tech points by 2d8. At the end of the high, the creature must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or experience a low that lasts 4 hours, their current and maximum tech points are reduced by 2d8. At the end of the low, the creature must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw to resist addiction.
